verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is an SDK for isolated code execution, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports event-driven automation, so the axis applies. The pack shows only developer primitives: a filesystem watcher with an onEvent callback (inotify), output callbacks, and Worker-based interception of outbound HTTP. A developer could build event-triggered automation from these, but there is no documented rules or trigger feature for defining event-to-action rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
